candidates.statement: Order service postgres save_order spans fail with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool shows size 5 and idle 0, so checkout requests time out at the gateway (502) and order returns 503. Pool exhaustion at the order->postgres boundary is the bounded root cause.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record only shows order v1.0.0 baseline; it does not establish deployment causation. Order traces were excluded from context.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout returns 502 with ~2s durations; traces show order->postgres save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0/size=5, order returning 503, and gateway ReadTimeout. Order metrics show 13.5/min 503s on /v1/orders and save_order dependency failures. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion at order->postgres.
